We are looking for a Director of Operations to own the systems, structure, and governance that allow our supply chain and fulfilment operation to scale reliably as we grow into a more complex, multi-brand business under the Hims & Hers umbrella.

This is a high-ownership role sitting at the intersection of operations, supply chain, commercial delivery, and cross-functional execution. You will be responsible for making sure the operation works - not just today, but as we transition to the Hims & Hers brand, treat more conditions, and grow order volumes over the next few years.

You will report into the VP of Operations Assurance at Hims & Hers, leading a small but growing team.

· Strategy & Planning: Define and own the annual supply chain strategy, OKRs, and volume forecasting, translating growth plans into resource, capex, and headcount.

· Supply Chain & Procurement: Manage end-to-end demand and supply planning, pharmaceutical and vendor relationships, and procurement governance across Rx and non-Rx categories.

· Order Management and Order Life Cycle: Manage Prescribe to Pharmacy process while executing exceptions and meeting appropriate SLA’s.

· Delivery & Patient Experience: Own courier strategy, carrier SLA management, and the delivery experience function as a retention lever.

· Cost & COGS: Own fulfilment cost per order and shipping targets, identifying and delivering initiatives to reduce COGS and wastage across the operation.

· Fulfilment Engineering & Systems: Own the roadmap for fulfilment systems (PMR, WMS, ERP) across our pharmacy and warehouse operations, partnering with engineering to deliver and govern them reliably at scale.

· Inventory Control: Manage IC related responsibilities including day to day but also month and quarter close while ensuring appropriate accounting and compliance measures to meet accuracy commitments.

· Cross-functional Launches: Lead supply chain input into new product and brand launches, coordinating across Commercial, Clinical, and Growth as we expand under Hims & Hers.

· Team & Org Design: Lead and grow a small team from day one, hiring key roles and building a high-accountability culture as the operation scales.

You are an experienced operations leader who thrives in high-growth environments where the pace is fast and the problems are genuinely complex. You know how to build structure without creating bureaucracy, and how to hold a high bar on execution without slowing the business down.

You are as comfortable in the weeds of a supply chain model or a fulfilment systems conversation as you are presenting a strategy to senior stakeholders. You are commercially sharp, operationally rigorous, and a natural cross-functional partner.

You are excited by the challenge of scaling an operation that is already moving quickly - bringing the systems, governance, and team capability needed to support a more complex, multi-brand business as Eucalyptus grows within the Hims & Hers portfolio.

· 8–12 years of experience in supply chain, operations, or a related function, with at least 3–4 years in a director or head-of level role with a team behind you

· Proven track record of owning end-to-end supply chain or fulfilment operations at scale - ideally in a high-growth, high-volume environment (e.g. e-commerce, health, consumer goods, mobility)

· Demonstrated ability to build and manage supplier and vendor relationships across complex, multi-category supply chains

· Strong commercial acumen - able to own COGS targets, model cost initiatives, and communicate financial impact clearly

· Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to define and deliver fulfilment system requirements & transformations (e.g. WMS, ERP, order management)

· Experience leading cross-functional product and category launches from an operations perspective

· Strong people leadership skills - able to hire, develop, and performance manage a growing team

· Excellent stakeholder management - confident presenting to exec and SLT-level audiences and partnering across commercial, clinical, and finance functions

· Based in London, with willingness to travel to Birmingham & Enfield on a regular basis

You will map milestones, clear operational bottlenecks, run rigorous status checks, and ensure our studio moves with high velocity without fracturing into silos. The entrepreneurial “get things done fast” is the most important criteria for Sunday. We are not looking for a traditional corporate administrator, building processes with long term effects or a high-level strategist who only builds slide decks. We are looking for an exceptionally hungry, agile operator to own end-to-end program and project management across our entire studio, who is focused on results.
This role is on fixed term - 1 year contract with the possibility of extension.

Own the Program & Project Lifecycle: Take immediate charge of tracking active cross-divisional programs, ensuring milestones are achieved on time and operational friction or project leakage is completely neutralized.
Enforce Cross-Functional Accountability: Act as the central node for project alignment. Conduct constant sprint and status check-ins with Game teams, UA managers, Data Scientists, and Developers. You are explicitly expected to have the difficult conversations required to resolve bottlenecks and challenge missing results.
Optimize Operational Handoffs: Standardize communication and workflows at critical project handoff points by ensuring all teams adhere strictly to formalized entry and exit criteria.
Drive Execution with an 80/20 ROI Focus: Evaluate project velocities against core business metrics (LTV, CPI, Spend, IAP, and absolute profit margin). Help teams maintain absolute focus on high-impact wins and flag low-value features drifting from our core roadmap.
Synthesize Leadership & Board Reporting: Transform complex project backlogs, program roadmaps, and cross-department timelines into crisp, data-backed status and blocker reports for senior executives and the board.

Agile Operator Mindset: You possess a profound generalist mindset. You are eager to master how multiple parts of our mobile entertainment value chain link together, translating program strategy directly into rapid execution.
Execution Grit: You operate with a lean, solution-driven mindset. You don't just manage by task lists; you manage by business outcomes. You own your time management and are accountable for delivery.
Transparent & Assertive Communicator: You practice direct, analytical, and respectful communication. You are completely unafraid to follow up cross-functionally for updates, expose alignment bottlenecks, or flag hidden project risks to leadership.
Project & Pipeline Specialist: You have exceptional logical tracking skills. You are highly proficient in using Jira, spreadsheets, and visual workflow tools to structure loose ideas into clean, scannable milestone roadmaps and program schedules.
Rapid Upskiller: You are an ambitious program professional looking to skip standard corporate ladders. You want to sit directly at the core of business operations, earning a masterclass in how a gaming studio scales by driving high-stakes commercial programs.
Fuel for the Adventure: What You Get at Sunday
Build Your Skills, Not Just Your CV: At Sunday, you grow by doing. Real ownership, fast feedback, and steep learning curves are the norm. We don’t just offer development programs – we offer real problems to solve and the space to own them.
Flexible Setup for Maximum Impact: We work in a hybrid setup with three core office days, plus flexibility where it matters.
Work Where It Feels Good: Our office has a 5th floor Alster lake view, strong coffee, top gear, and way too many snacks. But more than that – it’s a space designed for makers, thinkers, and game-changers to connect, collide, and build.
More Than Just a Job – Join the Crew: We don’t just work side by side. We share wins, tackle challenges, and have fun together. Team events, game nights, spontaneous pizza runs – they’re part of the ride. Work hard, play smart.
